question:
Which of the following terms will replace the question mark (?) in the given series?

CM, EP, GO, IS, KQ, MV, OS, ?
solution:
The position and positional value of English Alphabets are as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ca63fa0a9b1d8d94e9032be998e74b7faff301d8847e785439c04e89b02dfd4.png] 

The logic followed here is:

\ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eccb5b842c4fec707349e0bf62e9d3b1f5130b1f8b33d4bc7a0e33f9d8ef32be.png] 

So, **QY **will replace the question mark in the given series.

Hence, the correct answer is ***'Option 2'.***
